chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from his father, from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ribat, from Shu'ayb al-Haddad, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The father is the only one who annuls the marriage.
ai.seo_question: Who has the authority to annul a marriage contract for a daughter according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the exclusive authority of the father (or paternal grandfather) to annul the marriage contract of his virgin daughter, a key point of discussion in Shia fiqh regarding the validity of the wali's role. It underscores the father's guardianship (wilayah) in marital affairs, distinguishing his power of revocation from other potential guardians or the bride herself.
